ground_truth_failures.step_reason: The assistant tries to modify the address after the modifying the pending order items which is not supported currently per the domain policy.
ground_truth_failures.category_reason: The sequence of actions requested by the user or the user intent is not currently supported by the domain policy. It is not incorrect plan generation by the assistant as the user mentioned to modify the items and then modify the address sequentially.
